article.title: Why a Small Buffer Can Protect a Project
article.author: OpenAI learning editor

paragraphs.en:
A project plan often looks simple on paper. Task A finishes on Monday, Task B starts on Tuesday, and the final review happens on Friday. But real work does not always follow the perfect plan. A meeting can move, a file can arrive late, or a small technical problem can take longer than expected. This is why a small time buffer can be useful.

A buffer is extra time between important tasks or before a deadline. It is not the same as doing nothing. The purpose is to protect the project from normal uncertainty. For example, if a report usually takes three days, a team may plan four days before the next important step. If everything goes well, the team finishes early. If a small problem appears, the project can still stay on schedule.

Without a buffer, one late task can create a chain of delays. A designer waits for data, a reviewer waits for the designer, and a manager waits for the review. A one-day problem can then affect several people. A small buffer at an important point can stop the delay from spreading.

Buffers should not be added everywhere. Too much extra time can make a project slow. Teams should look for tasks with high uncertainty, outside dependencies, or difficult reviews. These are good places for a little protection.

It is also important to explain the buffer clearly. If people think the real deadline is later, they may simply start later. The team should keep the working deadline clear and treat the buffer as protection, not free time.

A good plan is not a plan where nothing ever changes. It is a plan that can handle small changes without becoming a crisis. A small buffer gives a team room to solve normal problems calmly and keep the larger project moving.
paragraphs.zh: 專案計畫在紙面上常看起來很順，但實際工作會遇到會議延期、檔案晚到或技術問題。Buffer 是重要任務之間或截止日前預留的一小段時間，不是閒置，而是用來吸收正常的不確定性。沒有 buffer 時，一個任務晚一天可能造成多人連鎖等待。Buffer 不應到處亂加，而應放在不確定性高、依賴外部或審查困難的環節。同時必須維持原本工作期限的清楚性，避免大家把 buffer 當成可以晚開始的時間。好的計畫不是永遠不變，而是遇到小變化仍能保持穩定。
paragraphs.ja: プロジェクトは計画通りに進むとは限らず、会議変更、資料遅延、技術問題などが起こります。bufferは重要taskの間やdeadline前に置く小さな余裕で、無駄な時間ではなく通常の不確実性を吸収するためのものです。bufferがなければ一日の遅れが複数人へ連鎖することがあります。ただし全工程に余裕を入れるのではなく、不確実性、外部依存、難しいreviewがある場所へ限定します。またbufferを本当のdeadlineだと思わせず、作業期限は明確に保つ必要があります。良い計画とは変化がない計画ではなく、小さな変化を危機にせず吸収できる計画です。
